notes: Transcribed from the three-page, text-layer PDF titled «لیست منابع آزمون ورودی دستیاری دندانپزشکی سال ۱۳۹۸», dated 2018-10-09 (PDF metadata). This is an official but explicitly incomplete first release: it covers eight subjects and lists English only as an Upper Intermediate level. It does not cover oral pathology, prosthodontics, community dentistry or dental materials. The PDF was shared in the University of Tehran dental student Telegram channel as message 3416, with a warning that not all subjects had been announced. Preserve provisional rows for the missing subjects until their official list is found. The printed Little/Falace 2018 edition number is erroneously 12th; the 2018 book is 9th. Craig 2018 is the 14th edition with a 2019 copyright.
